messages:
Ellen: heads-up: promo for release 2026-03-rc1 is blocked in the 16:00 UTC window. image-extract step failing on several runners with unexpected EOF / truncated layer. deploy-bot auto-held it. Anyone on-call seeing this pattern?
Sam: yikes. logs show "layer 2: unexpected EOF while reading blob" across us-east and ap-south runners. checksum in registry matches builder upload.
DeployBot: Automated Alert - promotion halted
  promo-id: 7102
  failed-step: image-extract
  sample-runner: us-east-4-runner-9
infra-bot: Observability: object-store PUT latency spike and 5xx errors between 1757778600-1757778750. Several multipart commits retried.
Victor: could be multipart commit visibility issue. Builders reported success, but edge nodes may still serve partial ranges. We had a similar transient last month.
Ellen: options: 1) pin to last known-good image (fast) 2) reupload blobs from builder host (quick but risky if builder file partial) 3) rebuild artifact and push new image (safe but misses change window). Thoughts?
ReleaseLead: prefer pin-old to avoid missing window, but add explicit note and open infra follow-up. If pinning, must run acceptance smoke on pinned image ASAP.
Sam: I'll run quick smoke on the previous tag (2026-03-beta5) against affected runners. Victor, please prepare a manual-promote PR if we go that route.
Victor: preparing manual-promote PR now. Also starting a blob-compare between builder and registry for the affected layer.
infra-bot: Observability update: 5xx spike subsided at 1757778888. No new write errors in last 2m.
Sam: smoke on 2026-03-beta5 -> PASS on us-east and ap-south. No extract errors.
Ellen: ok lock window for 45m and pin to 2026-03-beta5. Victor please attach the blob-diff logs and create INF ticket for object-store multipart visibility.
Victor: PR created: PR-2241, command: `/deploybot manual-promote PR-2241 lock-window 45m pin 2026-03-beta5`. INF-1512 created for follow-up. Blob diff shows registry blob identical on size and sha256 but earlier CDN partial-range logs suggest transient reassembly issue.
DeployBot: Manual promote request created; status: awaiting approval.
ReleaseLead: approved. Proceeding with manual promote. Add release note: "Canary pinned to prior image due to transient layer-extract EOF on some runners; rebuild and reupload scheduled after infra confirmation (see INF-1512)."
Ellen: thanks. keeping eyes on infra. If reupload + rebuild clears and infra confirms no more 5xx, we'll retry full promo path later today.
